Apartment for Rent in 17 Icon Bay, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons)

Discover modern waterfront living in this elegant 1-bedroom apartment in 17 Icon Bay, located in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour. The apartment offers a well-designed layout with bright interiors and a private balcony, perfect for enjoying the peaceful surroundings of the community.

Property Features:

1 Bedroom
1 Bathroom
Balcony
Built-in wardrobes
Spacious living area
Dining area
Modern kitchen with built-in cabinets

Amenities:

Shared swimming pool
Fully equipped gym
Children’s play area
High-speed service elevators
24/7 security

About the Community:

17 Icon Bay is a contemporary residential tower set within the vibrant Creek Island district of Dubai Creek Harbour. Residents enjoy breathtaking views of the iconic Dubai Creek Tower and the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, along with direct access to lush parklands, waterfront promenades, retail outlets, and dining destinations.

Ideal for those seeking a peaceful waterfront lifestyle while staying connected to the city’s key destinations.
